test_run_model: test the mmdet test.py script to run inference and evaluation on a detection model with a config and checkpoint
test_parse_args: test the parse_args function to parse CLI arguments including config, checkpoint, launcher, tta, and cfg-options for mmdet testing
test_enable_tta: test enabling test-time augmentation (tta) to improve detection model accuracy by flipping and aggregating predictions
test_dump_predictions: test dumping model predictions to a pickle file for offline evaluation using the --out argument
test_visualize_results: test visualizing detection prediction results on images with --show or --show-dir flags
